title: Run a .NET Assembly Step
description: Load a .NET DLL from the package and invoke its IKrakenStep implementation.

Kraken.Action.PackageRunner.AssemblyPath.label: Assembly path
Kraken.Action.PackageRunner.AssemblyPath.helpText: Path to the .dll relative to the package root (e.g. hooks/PostDeploy.dll).

Kraken.Action.PackageRunner.TypeName.label: Type name (optional)
Kraken.Action.PackageRunner.TypeName.helpText: Fully-qualified class name implementing IKrakenStep. Auto-discovered if the assembly has exactly one implementor.
